comment: BREAKING: fast convert --syntax=webui-prerelease now transfers Shadow/Light DOM attributes from the outer <f-template> onto the inner <template>, requires a braced f-ref (converted to w-ref), and rewrites FAST's $e event argument to e. Unsupported f-slotted/f-children directives are now stripped from the output with a printed warning instead of being preserved verbatim, and $c event context now errors. convert_template/convert_template_with_options (Rust, WASM, and the fast convert CLI) now also report these warnings alongside the converted output.
